F01.why: Recognizable purpose-specific silhouette in its actual view; structural masses split only at real connections; overlap order before detail; subpart contours follow the gesture; 1/10-size test.

F06.why: Whole gesture+support first; pose-specific garment silhouette; task-specific hand art (reach/pinch/hook/grip); contact graph actor.hand→prop.handle with near/far occlusion; alternate drawings for significant change.

F13.why: Luminous/optical materials need structure under the light

F15.why: Exactly one primary motion owner per region (CAMERA/WORLD/SUBJECT_RIGID/SUBJECT_PART/REDRAWN_STATE/MATERIAL_LIGHT/MASK/EFFECT/UI); simultaneous tracks; purposeful stillness.

F17.why: rendered hero frames from the production scene, inspected at native + 160×90

F18.why: Coverage states DECODED/VIEWED/NATIVE_INSPECTED/METHOD_MAPPED/OUTPUT_TESTED are separate; never claim inspection from frame counts.

F19.why: Production medium is conditional (vector / pixel illustration / infographic / selective 3D / hybrid) per visual demand.

F36.why: EPISODE.json → plan.mjs cues + per-subject ICD validated by icd.mjs; build fails closed

F37.why: abstract fields need no scenic horizon

F47.why: Detail tiers T0 skeleton / T1 modules / T2 parent-bound features / T3 state marks; marks need parent+function; erase-tier test.

F49.why: icd.mjs validation fails closed on missing world/topology/regions

F50.why: Adversarial unfamiliar-world transfer tests; no certification by resemblance.

F51.why: Palette = role map (substrate, far/mid support, focal, causal-active, local inset, optic) + contiguous parent-owned base fills + chosen contrast relationship.

F52.why: Mark count from screen role and size

F54.why: Repeats from a parent-owned generator in local frame with count/size/exclusion rules; zero repeats can be correct.

F56.why: ICD geometry is authored before render; first render inspected; repair edits the producing operation

F58.why: Closed parent regions (outer, front/back mass, cutout voids, supports) with identity-bearing negative spaces; small-size read; derived small forms collapse marks.

F59.why: Part DAG with insertion depth/in_front_of/hidden_when; joints with overlap masks; near fingers in front of prop, prop midplane, far fingers behind.

F61.why: Palette slots assigned after silhouette owners/neighbors; record luminance/hue/edge discrimination per adjacent pair.

F62.why: Edge roles per owner (COLOR_ADJACENCY, MATERIAL_SEAM, CAST_SHADOW, INTERNAL_CREASE, OPTICAL_RIM, EMISSIVE_EDGE); cast shadows on named receivers; patches by surface turning.

F64.why: Identity routed by family (ACTING_FACE, GESTURE_FULL_BODY, REAR, DISTANT, ORGANISM, MASCOT, GEAR) with canonical identity record.

F65.why: face_eye_mode chosen AFTER projected head size and emotional function

F66.why: Pelvis, shoulder axis, support foot, hand targets; arm segment seams hidden under sleeve/hand shapes; garments as large contours with collar/cuffs/hem; distinct views need drawings.

F80.why: the first construction must consume routed decisions (with witness ids) as INPUTS to the geometry functions; the build verifies each routed method's ops executed on its bound regions before the first render

witnesses.observed: clinic 3/4 heads: one skull volume, face plane turning with the head, near eye larger / far eye foreshortened, ear on the far contour, glasses as rims over the eye regions. AI@285 (unlike) small rear actor: no sclera.
moustache = darkest face mass with mouth below; close human: lid-cut sclera, large dark pupil, hair as 2–3 contiguous lobes, two-tone mitten hands.
limbs as large tapered masses continuous with their garments; sleeves overlap the next segment; hands sized large; lab coats raised above a dark support.
